# HYROX Training Club – group HYROX classes in Prague, Brno and Ostrava

> HYROX Training Club runs group HYROX classes in four Form Factory gyms in the Czech Republic. The clubs are licensed HYROX365 partners and train by the official HYROX365 group programming (Foundational, Engine, Power, Complete). Head coach: Ria Suchánek Hrušovská; coach Ladislav Suchánek. Classes are booked online in each club's timetable and are part of Form Factory membership.

## Clubs
- [Praha](https://hyroxtrainingclub.cz/praha/): Form Factory Na Knížecí, Ostrovského 464/6, 150 00 Praha 5 – Smíchov; Form Factory Vinohradská, Vinohradská 190, 130 00 Praha 3
- [Brno](https://hyroxtrainingclub.cz/brno/): Form Factory Campus, Palachovo náměstí 726/2, 625 00 Brno
- [Ostrava](https://hyroxtrainingclub.cz/ostrava/): Form Factory Hrabová, Krmelínská 646/22, 720 00 Ostrava
